task.description:
Write the test specification for EE-07 (Parallel gateway join) to `tests/specs/EE-07.md`.

Read EE-07 in `docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md` and the EE-07 design section in `src/design/engine.md`. Also read `tests/specs/EE-06.md` for the test pattern used on the split side.

The test spec MUST cover all 5 EE-07 acceptance criteria with concrete test cases:

1. **Join fires when all N active tokens arrive** — normal 2-branch join: both tokens arrive, join fires, single outgoing token created.
2. **Cancelled branch excluded** — 2-branch split, one branch cancelled, second branch arrives at join → join fires (threshold = 1, not 2).
3. **All branches cancelled** — 2-branch split, both branches cancelled → join is cancelled, instance transitions to CANCELLED, `INSTANCE_CANCELLED` event appended.
4. **Exactly-once** — concurrent arrival of two tokens at join: join fires exactly once, not twice.
5. **N > 2 branches** — 3-branch split: all 3 arrive at join → join fires once, 1 outgoing token.

For each test case specify:
- Test ID (EE-07-TC-01, EE-07-TC-02, etc.)
- Test type (unit or integration)
- Given / When / Then
- Expected events emitted in order
- Expected final InstanceState (active_tokens, status)

Also write the Zig unit test stubs in `tests/unit/test_ee07_parallel_join.zig` that implement the test cases. Use the `MockEngineState` pattern from existing unit tests (see `tests/unit/` for examples).

Validation checklist before completing:
- [ ] All 5 AC from EE-07 have at least one test case
- [ ] All-cancelled edge case has its own test case
- [ ] Exactly-once test case is included
- [ ] Zig unit test stubs compile (`zig build test` exits 0)
- [ ] tests/specs/EE-07.md is complete
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-07.md created with test cases covering all 5 EE-07 acceptance criteria
Cancelled-branch exclusion test case (AC-2 and AC-3)
Zig unit test file created at tests/unit/test_ee07_parallel_join.zig

result.summary: Created tests/specs/EE-07.md with 5 test cases covering all EE-07 acceptance criteria. TC-EE-07-01 through TC-EE-07-04 are referenced from their existing location in src/engine/transition.zig (private processNodeEntry tests); TC-EE-07-05 (3-branch join, N=3 via public transition() API) is newly implemented in tests/unit/test_ee07_parallel_join.zig. Registered the new test in build.zig. zig build test exits 0.
